chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from some of our companions, from Sayf ibn 'Umayrah, from Abi Hamzah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying: Whoever we have made lawful for him something that came to him from the acts of the oppressors, then it is lawful for him; and whatever of that we have forbidden, then it is forbidden for him.

key_terms.حَرَامٌ: forbidden and impermissible in legal ruling
key_terms.حَلَالٌ: lawful and permissible in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abi Ja'far عليه السلام say about what is halal or haram from the wealth connected to the oppressors?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام have declared certain property obtained through dealings connected to oppressive rulers to be halal for their Shi'ah, while other such property remains haram. In the chapter context, it relates to what they permitted from khums during the state of ghaybah and establishes a legal distinction based on their authorization.
